title: TTF vol spike momentum (reverse of R2-0037)
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] MOMENTUM (reverse of R2-0037): TTF absolute return 20d z-score > 1 (volatility spike) is followed by continuation, not a fade, over the next 3 days (+); trade long TTF=F 1-3d after the spike day [finance.TTF=F.abs_return -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0037)
message: Supported in-sample (r=0.23, n=391) but trade edge is war-regime only: 1d long after TTF abs-return z>1 gives hit 0.53, avg +0.59%, sharpe 0.91 (n=49); pre-war excess negative, war OOS +2.1%/trade (n=15). Heuristic judge scores 0; actionability 6.41.

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.TTF=F.abs_return rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] SIGNED MOMENTUM (refines R2-0136): the TTF vol-spike continuation edge exists only in the war regime (pre-war excess return negative), so test whether it is really 1-day signed momentum: TTF log-return 20d z-score > 1 (large UP day) is followed by a positive next-day return (+); trade long TTF=F for 1d after the up day, control against unsigned spikes [finance.TTF=F.log_return -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0136)
